# Code of Conduct

## Our pledge

We are committed to providing a welcoming, respectful, and harassment-free experience for everyone participating in this project.

## Expected behavior

Use respectful language, give constructive feedback, and focus discussions on improving the project.

## Unacceptable behavior

Harassment, discrimination, personal attacks, intimidation, and sharing others' private information without permission are not tolerated.

## Enforcement

Report concerns privately to the repository owner through GitHub. Reports will be reviewed promptly and confidentially where possible.
